-------------------------DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TRAN_AMT)),0) TRAN_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),RESERVATION_AMT)),0) RESERVATION_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),FX_TRAN_AMT)),0) FX_TRAN_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),RATE)),0) RATE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),REF_AMT)),0) REF_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TREA_RATE)),0) TREA_RATE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TS_CNT)),0) TS_CNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),REGULARIZATION_AMT)),0) REGULARIZATION_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT)),0) PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM)),0) USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM)),0) USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT)),0) USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN)),0) USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),USED_EMER_ADVN)),0) USED_EMER_ADVN_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, TRAN_AMT TRAN_AMT_src
, RESERVATION_AMT RESERVATION_AMT_src
, FX_TRAN_AMT FX_TRAN_AMT_src
, RATE RATE_src
, REF_AMT REF_AMT_src
, TREA_RATE TREA_RATE_src
, TS_CNT TS_CNT_src
, REGULARIZATION_AMT REGULARIZATION_AMT_src
, PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_src
, USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
, USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
, USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_src
, USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_src
, USED_EMER_ADVN USED_EMER_ADVN_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,TRAN_AMT_tgt
,RESERVATION_AMT_tgt
,FX_TRAN_AMT_tgt
,RATE_tgt
,REF_AMT_tgt
,TREA_RATE_tgt
,TS_CNT_tgt
,REGULARIZATION_AMT_tgt
,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_tgt
,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_tgt
,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_tgt
,USED_EMER_ADVN_tgt
,TRAN_AMT_src
,RESERVATION_AMT_src
,FX_TRAN_AMT_src
,RATE_src
,REF_AMT_src
,TREA_RATE_src
,TS_CNT_src
,REGULARIZATION_AMT_src
,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_src
,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_src
,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_src
,USED_EMER_ADVN_src
, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(TRAN_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TRAN_AMT_tgt
,CAST(RESERVATION_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) RESERVATION_AMT_tgt
,CAST(FX_TRAN_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) FX_TRAN_AMT_tgt
,CAST(RATE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) RATE_tgt
,CAST(REF_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) REF_AMT_tgt
,CAST(TREA_RATE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TREA_RATE_tgt
,CAST(TS_CNT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_tgt
,CAST(REGULARIZATION_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) REGULARIZATION_AMT_tgt
,CAST(PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_tgt
,CAST(USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
,CAST(USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
,CAST(USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_tgt
,CAST(USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_tgt
,CAST(USED_EMER_ADVN_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_EMER_ADVN_tgt
,CAST(TRAN_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TRAN_AMT_src
,CAST(RESERVATION_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) RESERVATION_AMT_src
,CAST(FX_TRAN_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) FX_TRAN_AMT_src
,CAST(RATE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) RATE_src
,CAST(REF_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) REF_AMT_src
,CAST(TREA_RATE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TREA_RATE_src
,CAST(TS_CNT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_src
,CAST(REGULARIZATION_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) REGULARIZATION_AMT_src
,CAST(PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_src
,CAST(USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
,CAST(USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
,CAST(USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_src
,CAST(USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_src
,CAST(USED_EMER_ADVN_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) USED_EMER_ADVN_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,TRAN_AMT_src
,RESERVATION_AMT_src
,FX_TRAN_AMT_src
,RATE_src
,REF_AMT_src
,TREA_RATE_src
,TS_CNT_src
,REGULARIZATION_AMT_src
,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_src
,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_src
,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_src
,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_src
,USED_EMER_ADVN_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,TRAN_AMT_tgt
,RESERVATION_AMT_tgt
,FX_TRAN_AMT_tgt
,RATE_tgt
,REF_AMT_tgt
,TREA_RATE_tgt
,TS_CNT_tgt
,REGULARIZATION_AMT_tgt
,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT_tgt
,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM_tgt
,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT_tgt
,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN_tgt
,USED_EMER_ADVN_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
